title: Plenty of Room in the Middle: Revealing Opportunities on a GPU Cluster via Fine-Grained Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.36329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GPU clusters have become essential computing resources for AI and scientific research in academia and industry. However, their high cost and growing demand often result in long queueing delays. While previous monitoring efforts have operated at second- or minute-level frequencies, they primarily informed job-level scheduling for clusters and lacked the detail needed to optimize GPU-level utilization.   This paper presents an in-depth study of a university research GPU cluster, analyzing resource usage at 100 ms intervals. We have developed a lightweight monitoring tool that leverages Nvidia's DCGM library to capture fine-grained "compute utilization" metrics within GPUs. tldr: 本文开发了一款基于DCGM库的轻量级细粒度（100毫秒级）GPU监控工具，并通过对大学GPU集群长达数月的监测数据分析，揭示了以往粗粒度监控无法发现的GPU利用率提升机会。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a lightweight, fine-grained (100 ms) GPU monitoring tool based on Nvidia's DCGM library and, through months of data collected from a university GPU cluster, reveals utilization optimization opportunities that coarse-grained monitoring fails to uncover.
